# appgatesdp_license (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the object.

### Read-Only

- `application_discovery` (Boolean) The old license feature name for Optimizer, kept for backward compatibility. Deprecated as of 7.0.
- `brokered_access_lease_time_hours` (Number) Number of hours Brokered Access will be reserved for users before they are reclaimable by others. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `collective_replication` (Boolean) Whether the Collective Replication feature is enabled. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `digital_experience_monitoring` (Boolean) The old license feature name for Observability, kept for backward compatibility. Deprecated as of 7.0.
- `error` (String) Error message if the License is not invalid.
- `expiration` (String) The expiration date of the license.
- `max_access_policies` (Number) The maximum access policies allowed by the license. If it's the usage details, then it's the amount of access policies in the system at present. Supported in API versions: v22, v23, v24.
- `max_brokered_access` (Number) The maximum amount of brokered access allowed by the license. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `max_connector_groups` (Number) The maximum Connector groups allowed by the license.
- `max_portal_users` (Number) The maximum Portal users allowed by the license.
- `max_service_users` (Number) The maximum Service users allowed by the license. Deprecated, use Local Users instead.
- `max_session_governance` (Number) The maximum amount of session governance allowed by the license. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `max_sites` (Number) The maximum sites allowed by the license. If it's the usage details, then it's the amount of sites in the system at present.
- `max_users` (Number) The maximum users allowed by the license.
- `max_users_single_site` (Number) The maximum Single Site client users allowed by the license. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `observability` (Boolean) Whether the Observability features are enabled. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `operational_technology` (Boolean) Whether the Operational Technology features are enabled. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `optimizer` (Boolean) Whether the Optimizer features are enabled. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `portal_users_lease_time_hours` (Number) Number of hours User Licenses will be reserved for Portal users before they are reclaimable by others.
- `request` (String) Request code for the license. If built-in license is in place, use this code to get a license. It's based on the CA certificate.
- `risk_engine` (Boolean) Whether the Risk Engine feature is enabled.
- `service_users_lease_time_hours` (Number) Number of hours User Licenses will be reserved for Service users before they are reclaimable by others. Deprecated, use Local Users instead.
- `session_governance_lease_time_hours` (Number) Number of hours Session Governance will be reserved for users before they are reclaimable by others. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `type` (Number) Type of the license. 1: production, 2: installation, 3: test, 4: built-in, 5: aws built-in, 6: metered
- `users_lease_time_hours` (Number) Number of hours User Licenses will be reserved for users before they are reclaimable by others.
- `users_single_site_lease_time_hours` (Number) Number of hours Single Site User Licenses will be reserved for users before they are reclaimable by others. Supported in API versions: v25.
- `verified_dns_names` (Attributes) Supported in API versions: v24, v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verified_dns_names))
- `version` (Number) License version.

<a id="nestedatt--verified_dns_names"></a>
### Nested Schema for `verified_dns_names`

Read-Only:

- `hashes` (List of String) The DNS names' hashes allowed by the license.
- `names` (List of String) The DNS names allowed by the license.
